# TileLayer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Render data organized in a tiled format (generic tile layer).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "TileLayerOp", "name": "tile-layer", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "layer"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
